nodes.description: Constant holding the initial token supply of 100,000,000 * 10**18.
Public constant bytes32 role identifier for burners.
Private mapping of account balances maintained by ERC20.
Private total token supply counter.
Private mapping of role data used by AccessControl.
Counters.Counter tracking the current snapshot identifier.
OjamuToken constructor: sets up DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE for the deployer and mints INITIAL_SUPPLY.
Public burn function restricted to callers holding BURNER_ROLE.
Public snapshot function restricted to callers holding DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
Internal ERC20 burn logic that reduces account balance and total supply.
Internal ERC20 mint logic that increases total supply and account balance.
Internal ERC20Snapshot function that creates a new snapshot id.
Internal ERC20 transfer logic moving balances between accounts.
AccessControl view returning whether an account holds a given role.
Caller address used for access control checks and initial role/token assignment.
Access control check requiring msg.sender to hold BURNER_ROLE in burn.
Access control check requiring msg.sender to hold DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE in snapshot.
Unchecked subtraction of amount from sender balance inside _transfer.
Unchecked subtraction of amount from account balance inside _burn.
Addition of amount to _totalSupply and account balance inside _mint.
Privileged _setupRole calls in constructor granting roles to the deployer.
uint256 amount parameter of the public burn function.
address account parameter of the internal _burn function.
uint256 amount parameter of the internal _burn function.
address account parameter of the internal _mint function.
uint256 amount parameter of the internal _mint function.
Local variable caching the sender balance in _transfer.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the account argument of the hasRole BURNER_ROLE check.
burn reverts unless the msg.sender passes the BURNER_ROLE check.
msg.sender is used as the account argument of the hasRole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE check.
snapshot reverts unless the msg.sender passes the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE check.
The amount parameter is consumed by the burn function body.
burn calls _burn to destroy tokens.
amount from burn is forwarded to the amount parameter of _burn.
account parameter of _burn identifies the account whose balance is reduced.
amount of tokens to be burned inside _burn.
_burn performs an unchecked subtraction of amount from the account balance.
_burn decreases _totalSupply by amount.
_burn writes the reduced balance back into the _balances mapping.
constructor calls _setupRole for DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE.
constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply.
msg.sender receives the admin role, burner role and the minted initial supply in the constructor.
amount parameter of _mint is used to increase supply and balance.
account parameter of _mint defines the recipient of minted tokens.
_mint adds amount to _totalSupply and to the recipient balance.
_mint credits the recipient balance in _balances.
snapshot calls the internal _snapshot function.
_snapshot reads the current snapshot id via _currentSnapshotId.
_snapshot increments _currentSnapshotId and returns the new id.
hasRole reads role membership from the _roles mapping.
hasRole result gates the BURNER_ROLE access control check in burn.
hasRole result gates the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE access control check in snapshot.
senderBalance local variable caches and is subtracted from in _transfer.
_transfer performs an unchecked subtraction from the sender balance.
_transfer updates sender and recipient balances in _balances.
constructor initialises role membership inside the _roles mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: amount is the only parameter of burn and is only meaningful inside that function.
account is a parameter of _burn and is only meaningful inside that function.
amount is a parameter of _burn and is only meaningful inside that function.
account is a parameter of _mint and is only meaningful inside that function.
amount is a parameter of _mint and is only meaningful inside that function.
senderBalance is a local variable used only in _transfer and can be folded into that function.
